questionnaire.Any other Feedback: The customer is currently unemployed, recently laid off from a tech company as a software developer, and is considering freelancing or starting their own company to secure a contract with a new firm instead of being hired as a full-time employee. They are unsure about the legal and tax implications of self-employment in Finland and are concerned about the process of changing their residence permit from a worker permit to an entrepreneur permit.
